definition: A Profile maps two agents and two test sentences to endorsement propositions. An Interpretation maps each profile and sentence to a proposition. Endorsement is independent input, not identified with truth; the profile tests change endorsement while holding an interpretation fixed. LogicalSentenceStable says the designated logical sentence holds at every profile. Profile invariance is a stipulated counterfactual test, not a sourced sufficient analysis of philosophical objectivity.
note: A minimal stipulated test semantics for #207, not a translation of every historical or modern use. A sourced defense and a translation from ordinary truth claims remain research obligations.
